exercises.instructionEn: Study the table, then complete the spelling rules.
exercises.instructionUz: Jadvalni o'rganing, so'ng imlo qoidalarini to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
JADVAL:
  SINGULAR   PLURAL
  loaf     - loaVES
  cherry   - cherrIES
  boy      - boyS
  tomato   - tomatoES

TO'LDIRILADIGAN QOIDALAR:

  1) Some nouns ending in -f or -fe drop the -f and take
     ............ to form their plural.
     = -f yoki -fe bilan tugagan ba'zi otlar -f ni tashlab,
       ko'plik yasash uchun ...... oladi.

  2) Nouns ending in a consonant + y, drop the -y and take
     ...... .
     = UNDOSH + y bilan tugagan otlar -y ni tashlab ...... oladi.

  3) Nouns ending in a vowel + y take -s.  (BERILGAN)
     = UNLI + y bilan tugagan otlar -s oladi.

  4) Some nouns ending in -o take ............ .
     = -o bilan tugagan ba'zi otlar ...... oladi.

DIQQAT — 2 va 3-QOIDANI SOLISHTIRING:
  cherRY  — 'r' UNDOSH + y → cherrIES
  boY     — 'o' UNLI + y  → boyS

items.textEn: Some nouns ending in -f or -fe drop the -f and take ............ to form their plural.
items.whyUz:
loaf → loaVES.
Boshqa misollar: knife → knives, leaf → leaves,
wife → wives, life → lives, shelf → shelves.
ISTISNO: roof → roofs, chief → chiefs.

items.textEn: Nouns ending in a consonant + y, drop the -y and take ............ .
items.whyUz:
cherry → cherrIES ('r' — undosh).
Boshqa misollar: strawberry → strawberries,
baby → babies, city → cities, story → stories.

items.textEn: Nouns ending in a vowel + y take ............ .
items.whyUz:
Kitobda BERILGAN qoida.
boy → boyS ('o' — unli).
Boshqa misollar: key → keys, day → days, toy → toys.

tomato → tomatoES.
Boshqa misollar: potato → potatoes, hero → heroes.
ISTISNO: photo → photos, piano → pianos, radio → radios.

exercises.instructionEn: Write the plural forms of the words below.
exercises.explanationUz:
Har bir so'z uchun 6-mashqdagi QAYSI qoida ishlashini aniqlang:
  -f / -fe → -VES
  undosh + y → -IES
  unli + y → -S
  -o → -ES

items.whyUz:
4-qoida: -o → -ES = potatoES.
'potatos' XATO.

1-qoida: -fe → -VES = kniVES.
Talaffuz: knife /naɪf/ → knives /naɪvz/ ('k' o'qilmaydi).
2-qoida: undosh ('r') + y → -IES = strawberrIES.

1-qoida: -f → -VES = leaVES.
'a leaf' = barg (42-betdagi koala matnida bor edi).

3-qoida: unli ('e') + y → -S = keyS.
DIQQAT: 'keies' XATO — 'e' unli, shuning uchun y o'zgarmaydi.

exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI TURDAGI OT:

  COUNTABLE (sanaladigan)
     Sanash mumkin: 1/2/3/4 apples
     BIRLIK va KO'PLIK shakli bor: an apple / apples
     'a/an' bilan keladi

  UNCOUNTABLE (sanalmaydigan)
     Sanab bo'lmaydi: some meat, some sugar
     Faqat BIRLIK shakli bor
     'a/an' bilan KELMAYDI

QOIDALAR:
  • A/AN faqat SANALADIGAN otning BIRLIGI bilan:
       a tomato, an egg
       'A SUGAR' XATO!
  • SOME ikkalasi bilan ham:
       sanaladigan KO'PLIK: some biscuits
       sanalmaydigan:       some bread

QANDAY ANIQLASH:
  Otning oldiga son qo'yib ko'ring:
     'two apples' — mumkin → SANALADIGAN
     'two sugars' — mumkin emas → SANALMAYDIGAN

SANALMAYDIGAN OTLAR ODATDA:
  suyuqlik (water, milk, juice, coffee, tea)
  kukun/donador (sugar, salt, flour, rice)
  massa (bread, cheese, meat, butter, jam, honey, ham)

points.en: Countable nouns are those which we can count. They have singular and plural forms. — 1/2/3/4 apples
points.uz: Sanaladigan otlar — sanash mumkin bo'lganlari. Ularning birlik va ko'plik shakli bor. — 1/2/3/4 olma

points.en: Uncountable nouns are those which we cannot count. They have only singular forms. — some meat/sugar
points.uz: Sanalmaydigan otlar — sanab bo'lmaydiganlari. Ularning faqat birlik shakli bor. — bir oz go'sht/shakar

points.en: A/An is only used with countable nouns in the singular. — a tomato / an egg (NOT: a sugar)
points.uz: A/An faqat sanaladigan otning birligi bilan ishlatiladi. — bitta pomidor / bitta tuxum ('a sugar' EMAS)
points.noteUz: 'an' — UNLI TOVUSH bilan boshlanadigan so'z oldida: an egg, an apple, an onion.

points.en: Some is used with either countable nouns in the plural or uncountable nouns. — some bread / some biscuits
points.uz: Some sanaladigan otning ko'pligi yoki sanalmaydigan ot bilan ishlatiladi. — bir oz non / bir nechta pechene
points.noteUz:
'either ... or ...' = yo ... yo ...
DIQQAT: 'some' SANALADIGAN BIRLIK bilan ISHLATILMAYDI:
'some apple' — noto'g'ri (agar bitta olma bo'lsa 'an apple').

exercises.instructionEn: First, say which nouns are countable and which are uncountable, then fill in a/an or some.
exercises.instructionUz: Avval qaysi otlar sanaladigan va qaysilari sanalmaydigan ekanini ayting, so'ng a/an yoki some qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
15 TA SO'Z RASMLAR BILAN BERILGAN:
  honey, tomatoes, jam, rice, coffee, cherries,
  egg, ham, sugar, flour, sandwich, butter,
  water, salt, pepper

QANDAY TANLANADI:
  SANALADIGAN BIRLIK  → a / an
     an egg, a sandwich
  SANALADIGAN KO'PLIK → some
     some tomatoes, some cherries
  SANALMAYDIGAN       → some
     some honey, some rice, some water

DIQQAT — 'an' QACHON:
  Unli TOVUSH bilan boshlansa: an egg, an apple, an onion.

DIQQAT — 'pepper' IKKI MA'NODA:
  a pepper (sanaladi) = bulg'or qalampiri (sabzavot)
  pepper (sanalmaydi) = qora qalampir (ziravor)
  Rasmda ZIRAVOR idishi bor → SANALMAYDIGAN → some pepper.

items.whyUz:
SANALMAYDIGAN (suyuq massa) → SOME honey.
'a honey' XATO. 'two honeys' ham noto'g'ri.

SANALADIGAN, lekin KO'PLIKDA → SOME tomatoes.
Bittasi bo'lsa: 'a tomato'.

SANALMAYDIGAN → SOME jam.
'jam' = murabbo, jem.

SANALMAYDIGAN → SOME rice.
Donalarini sanab bo'lmaydi.

SANALMAYDIGAN → SOME coffee.
DIQQAT: restoranda 'two coffees' deyish mumkin —
bu 'ikki piyola qahva' degani (qisqartma shakl).

SANALADIGAN, KO'PLIKDA → SOME cherries.
Bittasi: 'a cherry'.

items.hintUz: Bitta tuxum, unli tovush bilan boshlanadi
items.whyUz:
SANALADIGAN, BIRLIKDA → 'an' (unli tovush → AN).
'a egg' XATO.

SANALMAYDIGAN → SOME ham.
'ham' = dudlangan cho'chqa go'shti.

SANALMAYDIGAN → SOME sugar.
Nazariya qutisida ham misol sifatida berilgan: 'NOT: a sugar'.

SANALMAYDIGAN → SOME flour.
'flour' /ˈflaʊə/ = un.
DIQQAT: 'a flower' /ˈflaʊə/ = gul — bir xil o'qiladi!

SANALADIGAN, BIRLIKDA → 'a sandwich'.
Ko'pligi: sandwiches (-ch → -ES).

SANALMAYDIGAN → SOME butter.
'butter' = sariyog'.

SANALMAYDIGAN → SOME water.
Sanash uchun: 'a glass of water'.
SANALMAYDIGAN → SOME salt.

Rasmda ZIRAVOR (qora qalampir) → SANALMAYDIGAN → SOME pepper.
DIQQAT: 'a pepper' = bulg'or qalampiri (sabzavot, sanaladi).

exercises.instructionEn: We can use countable and uncountable nouns after phrases of quantity such as: slice, bottle, glass, packet, kilo, loaf, cup, carton, piece + of.
exercises.instructionUz: Sanaladigan va sanalmaydigan otlarni miqdor iboralaridan keyin ishlatishimiz mumkin: slice, bottle, glass, packet, kilo, loaf, cup, carton, piece + of.
exercises.explanationUz:
MIQDOR IBORALARI — SANALMAYDIGAN OTNI SANASH USULI.

QOLIP: a/two/three + MIQDOR SO'ZI + OF + ot

  a slice OF bread     — bir bo'lak non
  a bottle OF wine     — bir shisha vino
  a glass OF water     — bir stakan suv
  a packet OF crisps   — bir paket chips
  a kilo OF sugar      — bir kilo shakar
  a loaf OF bread      — bir non (butun)
  a cup OF tea         — bir piyola choy
  a carton OF milk     — bir paket sut
  a piece OF cheese    — bir bo'lak pishloq
  a bowl OF soup       — bir kosa sho'rva

DIQQAT: 'OF' HECH QACHON TUSHIB QOLMAYDI.
  'a glass water' XATO → 'a glass OF water'

KO'PLIK: miqdor so'zi ko'plikka o'tadi, ot esa o'zgarmaydi:
  two glassES of water,  three cupS of tea

points.en: a slice of bread / cake / pizza
a bottle of wine / water / Coke
a glass of wine / water / juice
a packet of crisps / cereal / sugar
a kilo of sugar / flour / potatoes
a piece of cheese / cake / paper
points.noteUz: 'a piece' — eng UMUMIY so'z, deyarli hamma narsaga mos.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct words from the list.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: slice, bottle, glass, packet, bowl, loaf, cup,
         carton, piece

RASMLARGA QARAB ANIQLANADI:
  1 — shisha idish        → bottle (BERILGAN)
  2 — butun dumaloq non   → loaf
  3 — taxtadagi pishloq   → piece
  4 — qadah (oyoqli)      → glass
  5 — paket (chipsli)     → packet
  6 — qog'oz quti (sutli) → carton
  7 — kesilgan non bo'lagi → slice
  8 — likopchali chashka  → cup
  9 — chuqur idish        → bowl

DIQQAT — 2 va 7-BANDNI SOLISHTIRING:
  a LOAF of bread  = butun non
  a SLICE of bread = bir bo'lak (kesilgan) non

items.whyUz: Kitobda BERILGAN javob. Rasmda shisha idish.

'a loaf of bread' = bir butun non.
Ko'pligi: LOAVES (6-mashqdagi qoida).
7-band bilan solishtiring: u yerda KESILGAN bo'lak.

'a piece of cheese' = bir bo'lak pishloq.
'a piece' — eng umumiy so'z, deyarli hamma narsaga mos.

'a glass of wine' = bir qadah vino.
1-band bilan solishtiring: 'a BOTTLE of wine' — butun shisha.

'a packet of crisps' = bir paket chips.
Britancha; amerikacha 'a bag of chips'.

'a carton of milk' = bir paket sut.
'a carton' — qog'ozdan yasalgan to'rtburchak idish.

'a slice of bread' = bir bo'lak (kesilgan) non.
2-band bilan solishtiring: 'a LOAF' — butun non.

'a cup of coffee' = bir piyola qahva.
'a cup' — issiq ichimlik uchun, dastasi bor.

'a bowl of soup' = bir kosa sho'rva.
55-betda ham bor edi: 'a bowl of ice-cream'.

exercises.instructionEn: Match these nouns to the words in the list in Ex. 9a.
exercises.explanationUz:
OTLAR: Coke, flour, cake, juice, water, tea, cereal, sugar

9a-RO'YXAT: slice, bottle, glass, packet, bowl, loaf,
            cup, carton, piece

BA'ZI OTLAR BIR NECHA MIQDOR SO'ZI BILAN KELADI —
qanday IDISHDA ekaniga qarab.

UMUMIY QOIDALAR:
  suyuqlik → bottle, glass, carton, cup
  kukun    → packet, kilo
  qattiq   → slice, piece
  yumshoq/donador → bowl, packet

items.answer: a bottle of Coke / a glass of Coke
items.whyUz:
Kola shishada sotiladi (a bottle), stakanga quyiladi (a glass).
'Coke' — bosh harf bilan (marka nomi).

Un paketda sotiladi → 'a packet of flour'.
'a kilo of flour' ham to'g'ri (nazariya qutisida 'kilo' bor).

items.answer: a slice of cake / a piece of cake
items.whyUz:
Tort kesib beriladi → 'a slice' yoki 'a piece'.
DIQQAT: 'a piece of cake' — idioma sifatida ham ishlatiladi:
'juda oson ish' degani.

items.answer: a carton of juice / a glass of juice
items.whyUz:
Sharbat qog'oz paketda sotiladi (a carton), stakanga quyiladi (a glass).
'a bottle of juice' ham mumkin.

items.answer: a bottle of water / a glass of water
items.whyUz: Suv shishada sotiladi (a bottle), stakanga quyiladi (a glass).

'a cup of tea' — o'zgarmas ibora.
DIQQAT: Britaniyada 'a cup of tea' — kundalik hayotning ramzi.
Idioma: 'It's not my cup of tea' = bu menga yoqmaydi.

items.answer: a bowl of cereal / a packet of cereal
items.whyUz:
'cereal' = nonushta uchun donli xlopya.
Paketda sotiladi (a packet), kosada yeyiladi (a bowl).

items.answer: a packet of sugar / a kilo of sugar
items.whyUz:
Shakar paketda sotiladi.
Choyga qo'shish uchun: 'a spoonful of sugar' (bir qoshiq).

sections.title: Speaking — offering food and drink
sections.titleUz: Gapirish — ovqat va ichimlik taklif qilish

exercises.instructionEn: Listen to the dialogues and repeat. Then, use the prompts below to act out similar dialogues.
exercises.instructionUz: Dialoglarni tinglang va takrorlang. So'ng quyidagi so'zlar bilan shunga o'xshash dialoglar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI NAMUNA DIALOG:

  1) ICHIMLIK haqida (I'm thirsty)
  2) OVQAT haqida (I'm hungry)

ASOSIY IBORALAR:
  I'm thirsty. = Chanqadim.
  I'm hungry.  = Qornim ochdi.
  Is there anything to drink/eat? = Ichgani/yegani bir narsa bormi?
  Would you like ...? = ... xohlaysizmi? (MULOYIM taklif)
  No, thanks. = Yo'q, rahmat. (muloyim rad etish)
  How about ...? = ...-chi? (boshqa taklif)
  Oh, yes, please! = Ha, iltimos!
  I'd love ... = Men ... juda xohlardim. (= I would love)

DIQQAT — 'SOME' yoki 'A':
  SANALMAYDIGAN → some orange juice, some Coke, some tea
  SANALADIGAN BIRLIK → a ham sandwich, a cheese sandwich

example.speaker: A (1-dialog)
example.en: I'm thirsty. Is there anything to drink?

example.speaker: B
example.en: Would you like some orange juice?

example.speaker: A
example.en: No, thanks. I don't like orange juice.
example.uz: Yo'q, rahmat. Men apelsin sharbatini yoqtirmayman.

example.speaker: A
example.en: Oh, yes, please! I'd love some Coke!
example.uz: Ha, iltimos! Men kolani juda xohlardim!

example.speaker: A (2-dialog)
example.en: I'm hungry. Is there anything to eat?
example.uz: Qornim ochdi. Yegani bir narsa bormi?

example.speaker: B
example.en: Would you like a ham sandwich?

example.speaker: A
example.en: No, thanks. I don't like ham.

example.speaker: A
example.en: Oh, yes, please! I'd love a cheese sandwich!
example.uz: Ha, iltimos! Men pishloqli buterbrodni juda xohlardim!

exercises.instructionEn: Then, use the prompts below to act out similar dialogues.
exercises.instructionUz: So'ng quyidagi so'zlar bilan shunga o'xshash dialoglar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
BERILGAN SO'ZLAR (yoqtirilmagan / yoqtirilgan):
  coffee / tea            — ichimlik
  beer / mineral water    — ichimlik
  spaghetti / soup        — ovqat
  chips / hamburger       — ovqat

ICHIMLIK bo'lsa: 'I'm thirsty. Is there anything to DRINK?'
OVQAT bo'lsa:    'I'm hungry. Is there anything to EAT?'

BARCHA SO'ZLAR SANALMAYDIGAN yoki KO'PLIK —
faqat 'a hamburger' sanaladigan birlik.

items.question: I'm thirsty. Is there anything to drink? — Would you like some coffee?
items.answer: No, thanks. I don't like coffee. — How about some tea? — Oh, yes, please! I'd love some tea!
items.whyUz: 'coffee' va 'tea' — SANALMAYDIGAN → SOME bilan.

items.question: I'm thirsty. Is there anything to drink? — Would you like some beer?
items.answer: No, thanks. I don't like beer. — How about some mineral water? — Oh, yes, please! I'd love some mineral water!
items.whyUz:
'beer' va 'mineral water' — SANALMAYDIGAN → SOME bilan.
'mineral water' = mineral suv.

items.question: I'm hungry. Is there anything to eat? — Would you like some spaghetti?
items.answer: No, thanks. I don't like spaghetti. — How about some soup? — Oh, yes, please! I'd love some soup!
items.whyUz:
'spaghetti' va 'soup' — SANALMAYDIGAN → SOME bilan.
DIQQAT: 'spaghetti' italyanchada ko'plik, lekin inglizchada
SANALMAYDIGAN ot: 'spaghetti IS delicious'.

items.question: I'm hungry. Is there anything to eat? — Would you like some chips?
items.answer: No, thanks. I don't like chips. — How about a hamburger? — Oh, yes, please! I'd love a hamburger!
items.whyUz:
'chips' — KO'PLIK → SOME bilan.
'a hamburger' — SANALADIGAN BIRLIK → 'A' bilan ('some' XATO).

groups.explanationUz: Ko'pchilik -o li otlar -es oladi, lekin istisnolar bor.
Sanalmaydigan otni sanash uchun ishlatiladi. 'OF' shart.

groups.ruleUz: Taklif qilish va rad etish iboralari

patterns.formula: A/AN + sanaladigan BIRLIK  /  SOME + sanaladigan KO'PLIK yoki sanalmaydigan.
patterns.exampleEn: an egg, a sandwich / some tomatoes, some bread
patterns.exampleUz: bitta tuxum, bitta buterbrod / pomidorlar, bir oz non
patterns.explanationUz:
'a sugar' XATO — 'sugar' sanalmaydi.
'some apple' ham noto'g'ri, agar bitta olma bo'lsa → 'an apple'.

patterns.exampleEn: a glass of water, two cups of tea, a loaf of bread
patterns.exampleUz: bir stakan suv, ikki piyola choy, bir non
patterns.explanationUz:
'OF' hech qachon tushib qolmaydi.
Ko'plikda MIQDOR so'zi o'zgaradi: two glassES of water.

patterns.formula: I'm thirsty/hungry. Is there anything to drink/eat?
patterns.exampleEn: I'm thirsty. Is there anything to drink?
patterns.explanationUz:
'anything' — savolda 'biror narsa'.
'to drink/eat' — 'anything' dan keyin 'to + fe'l'.

patterns.formula: Would you like + some/a + ovqat? — No, thanks. / Yes, please.
patterns.exampleEn: Would you like some orange juice? — No, thanks.
patterns.explanationUz: 'Would you like ...?' — eng muloyim taklif shakli.

patterns.formula: How about + some/a + ovqat? — Oh, yes, please! I'd love ...
patterns.exampleEn: How about some Coke? — Oh, yes, please! I'd love some Coke!
patterns.exampleUz: Kola-chi? — Ha, iltimos! Men kolani juda xohlardim!
patterns.explanationUz: 'How about ...?' — birinchi taklif rad etilgach, ikkinchisi.

patterns.exampleEn: loaf → loaves, cherry → cherries, boy → boys, tomato → tomatoes
patterns.exampleUz: non → nonlar, gilos → giloslar, bola → bolalar, pomidor → pomidorlar
patterns.explanationUz: Avval OXIRGI HARFLARGA qarang, so'ng qoidani tanlang.
